posts.title: Quick Security Update
posts.description: SuperDuper 4.0.10 includes a security update that addresses a recently reported CVE (CVE-2026-107067). macOS Privacy Protection ( TCC 1 ) Normally, on your startup drive, macOS protects personal information (Contacts, Documents, and the like) behind security prompts that I’m sure you’ve seen. When an Application tries to access the data, the user is prompted to confirm that’s what they want. Snaps
